# Social sign-in brand assets

Retrieved 2026-10-02 for the provider sign-in buttons. Provider trademarks remain the property of their owners. These assets are not covered by the application's code license.

- **Google** — `public/brand/social/google.png`: current gradient G, downloaded unchanged from https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/g-logo.png. [Branding guidelines](https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines).
- **NAVER** — `public/brand/social/naver.png`: unchanged `NAVER_login_KR/NAVER_login_Light_KR_green_icon_H56.png` from [official Korean asset archive](https://developers.naver.com/inc/devcenter/downloads/bi/NAVER_login_KR.zip). The icon's internal whitespace is preserved. [Button guide](https://developers.naver.com/docs/login/bi/bi.md).
- **Kakao** — `public/brand/social/kakao.svg`: speech-bubble path from https://developers.kakao.com/tool/images/resource/preview/login-complete-ko.svg, isolated using its original path coordinates; black fill follows the [design guide](https://developers.kakao.com/docs/ko/kakaologin/design-guide). The symbol is not a text bullet or Kakao corporate wordmark.
- **Apple** — `public/brand/social/apple.svg`: unchanged `Sign in with Apple - Left Aligned/SVG/Logo - SIWA - Left-aligned - White - Medium.svg` from Apple's [Sign in with Apple logo artwork](https://devimages-cdn.apple.com/design/resources/download/Logo-Sign-in-with-Apple.dmg), under the accompanying Developer Artwork License Agreement. [Design resources](https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/).

The change corrects button artwork only. It does not enable or imply completed OAuth integrations.
